Name: Sebastian Portrait Replacement Mod
Author: Adree23
Description:
[b]How to Install[/b] (I'm not an expert on modding so this may not be the most efficient):

[list]
[*]Unzip the folder labelled Liorlen - Sebastian Portrait Mod and go into the Portraits folder. The other folder is just the .png file of the portraits.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Copy Sebastian.xnb and then go to C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content. If you can't find this, your Stardew Valley folder may be in a different place such as Program Files (x86). Open the Portraits folder there and paste Sebastian.xnb and let it replace the file that was already there.
[/list][b]
If you have any issues please tell me.[/b] And if you like this mod, please let me know! I'm mostly making these to get better at pixel art at this point.

Thank you for reading, and I'll see about making more character portrait mods if there's any interest.

Downloads.Description: .zip folder containing character portraits and their .png files.
